3# ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT between 59 EAST 126 LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an address at c/o STREET EQUITIES LLC, a New York limited liability company, having its principal place of business at c/o Artimus, 316 West 118th Street, New York, NY 10026 ("Developer"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner owns that certain tracts plot and parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements constructed or to be constructed thereon, located in the County of New York, City and State of New York, known as 59 East 126"h Street, New York, New York and designated as Block 1751, Lot 32 on the Tax Map of The City ofNew York, New York County (the “Tax Map"), all as more particularly described on Exhibit A annexed hereto (said land and any additional land hereafter added by Owner as an Enlargement pursuant to Article 9 hereof are herein collectively referred to as “Owner's Parcel” and the buildings and improvements (including the Owner New Building) now or hereafter thereon are herein collectively referred to as “Owner's Building" and said land, building and improvements being herein collectively referred to as the “Owner's Property"); WHEREAS, Developer owns that certain tract, plot and parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements constructed or to be constructed thereon, located in the County of New York, City and State of New York, known as and by the street address 1844 Park Avenue, New York, NY with the buildings and improvements thereon and more particularly described in Exhibit B annexed hereto and made a part hereofand known Block 1751, Lot 33 on the Tax Map, all as more particularly described on Exhibit B annexed hereto (said land and any additional land hereafter added by Developer as an Enlargement pursuant to Article 9 hereof are herein collectively referred · . to as "Developer's Parcel” and the buildings and improvements (including the New Building) now or hereafter thereon are herein collectively referred to as “Developer's Building" and said land, building and improvements being herein collectively referred to as the “Developer's Property"); WHEREAS, Owner's Property and Developer's Property (herein collectively called the within a single block pursuant to the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York effective as of December 15, 1961, as amended (the “Zoning Resolution"); WHEREAS,Developer and Owner desire to utilize the procedure available pursuant to the Zoning Resolution for combining Owner's Parcel and Developer's Parcel into a single “zoning building(s) on the Developer's Parcel; 1

WHEREAS, Owner and Developer desire to set forth the rights and obligations of each with respect to development and certain related activities on their respective portions of the single zoninglot to be created simultaneouslyherewith; and WHEREAS, Owner and Developer have simultaneously with the execution of this Agreement entered into a certainProtection andUnderpinningLicenseAgreement of even date herewith, which inter alia,_, permits Developer (i) to install and maintain certain protective measures and perform underpinning at Owner's Parcel tofacilitate the safe and timely construction of and necessary support for the New Building, as defined herein, and (i) to perform a pre- construction survey of Owner's Parcel, all subject to and in accordance with the terms and conditions of said Protection and Underpinning  License Agreement ("Protection and Underpinning License Agreement'); a memorandum of the Protection and Underpinning License Agreement is being executed by Owner and Developer simultaneously herein and is intended to be recorded in the Office of the City Register of New York County. NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the covenants and agreements herein contained, the parties hereto covenant and agree as follows: Certain Definitions. As used herein: A.“Additional DevelopmentRights”shallmeananyadditionalFloorAreaDevelopment Rights that may become available to theDeveloper's Parcel or theSingle Zoning Lot, below), by special permit, variance, or by any other procedure or transfer allowed under the provisions of the Zoning Resolution, including, without limitation, Sections 34-223, 35-35; 74-711; 74-79 et seq. and 23-90 et seq. thereof). B. "Excess Development Rights”shall mean all ofthe Floor AreaDevelopment Rights (as hereinafter defined) appurtenant to Owner's Land which are in excess of the Utilized Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) and are available for transfer pursuant to the Zoning Resolution. C. "Transferred Development Rights”means 6,600 square feet ofExcess Development Rights which are being transferred by Owner to, and acquired by, Developer pursuant to this Agreement. D. "Floor Area Development Rights" or_"Development Rights” shall mean the rights, as determined in accordance with the Zoning Resolution, which are appurtenant to a zoning lot, to develop the zoning lot by erecting thereon a structure or structures with a total floor area determined (i) by multiplying the area of the zoning lot by the maximum allowable floor area ratio for structures in the zoning district or districts in which such zoning lot is located, and (ii) by the inclusion of any available bonus floor area development rights permitted under the Zoning Resolution and which may be authorized to be developed by the appropriate City Agency (as defined in Section 8.3 below) from time to time. E."Lot Coverage" That portion of a zoning lot which, when viewed directly from above, would be covered by a building or any part of a building. For a residential building or residential portion of a building, the portion of any balcony which does not project from the face of the building shall be counted as lot coverage, but other obstructions permitted pursuant to Section 23-44 (Permitted Obstructions in Required Yards or Rear Yard Equivalents) shall not be included in lot coverage. 2
